# ANALYSIS: LIVE_PRICE_FIRST_BAR_TRIGGER WALK-FORWARD OOS AND REAL-FILLS VALIDATION

**Filed:** 2026-07-22
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that the LIVE_PRICE_FIRST_BAR_TRIGGER candidate, when tested on walk-forward OOS (2024-01-02..2024-12-31), will achieve a Sharpe ratio >=0.70 and that the real-fills simulation on the top 3 J days will be within ±20% of the BS-sim.

## Mechanism

The LIVE_PRICE_FIRST_BAR_TRIGGER fires on the first bar of the day (09:30-09:35 ET) if the opening price is at the premarket low (for bearish setups) or premarket high (for bullish setups) and then shows an immediate reversal (close opposite the open direction). For bearish entries: open == premarket low and close > open (bullish reversal) triggers a PUT entry at the next bar open. For bullish entries: open == premarket high and close < open (bearish reversal) triggers a CALL entry at the next bar open. The trigger requires the premarket level to be defined (based on the first 5 minutes of the pre-market session, 04:00-09:25 ET). Entry uses limit at mid-price of the next bar. Exit follows the standard BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON rules: chart stop (rejected level + $0.50 buffer), chandelier profit-lock (arms at +5%, trails 15%), TP1 at +50% (sell 2/3), runner to exit on ribbon re-entry or TP2 at +200%, time stop 15:50 ET.
